items.title: Istanbul to host 2027 Super Cup
items.description: Barça set to play for first trophy of the season in the Turkish city from 2 to 7 February

items.title: Barça Academy Tunisia set to open
items.description: Club invests in a country where football is one of the most popular sports

items.title: Everyone in group training
items.description: Hansi Flick coaches a session with all players now in group training

items.title: Barça 3-1 Montpeller: Winning start
items.description: Pere Romeu’s side beat Montpellier in front of the home fans in their first preseason friendly

items.title: Roony Bardghji surgery a success
items.description: Swede's operation this Wednesday goes as planned

items.title: Double session completed
items.description: Dani Olmo, Pedri, Jules Kounde, Gordon, Bisiwu, Joan Garcia, Cubarsí, Lamine Yamal and Eric Garcia continued to follow individual training programmes during the afternoon session
items.descriptionZh: 亚马尔、奥尔莫、库巴西和佩德里全部参加了周三的双练。

items.title: Women's preseason live on Barça Play and YouTube
items.description: The games against Brighton & Hove Albion, Montpellier and Manchester City will be available to subscribers on the club’s official channels
items.titleZh: 巴萨女足季前赛将在 Barça Play 与 YouTube 直播
items.descriptionZh: 对阵布莱顿、蒙彼利埃和曼城的比赛将通过俱乐部官方频道向订阅用户播出。

items.title: Barça and Basel's many connections
items.description: Barça have strong ties with the Swiss club, with the two sharing the same initials and colours
items.titleZh: 巴萨与巴塞尔之间的诸多联系
items.descriptionZh: 两家俱乐部拥有相同的英文缩写和相近的代表色，彼此之间也有深厚渊源。

items.title: Roony Bardghji injury news
items.description: Swede has suffered rupture of anterior cruciate ligament in right knee
items.descriptionZh: 这名瑞典球员右膝前十字韧带断裂。

items.title: This is the 2026/27 third strip
items.description: Shirt, which goes on sale this Wednesday 12 August, features shades of green and celebrates a generation of players who grew up dreaming of wearing the club crest
items.titleZh: 2026/27 赛季第三球衣正式发布
items.descriptionZh: 新球衣采用绿色调，致敬从小梦想身披俱乐部战袍的一代球员，并于 8 月 12 日开始发售。

items.title: Google Gemini and Google Pixel become new partners
items.description: The collaboration will reinvent the way fans experience football through artificial intelligence and advanced mobile technology, alongside the Club's men's and women's first football teams
items.titleZh: Google Gemini 与 Google Pixel 成为巴萨新合作伙伴
items.descriptionZh: 双方将通过人工智能和先进移动技术，围绕男足与女足一线队重新构想球迷体验。

items.title: Commitment to the Victims of the Humanitarian Emergency Following the Earthquake in Colombia with a €100,000 Donation
items.description: FC Barcelona and its Foundation are launching an extraordinary fundraising campaign to respond to the humanitarian emergency affecting thousands of people in Colombia, in collaboration with leading organizations operating on the ground.
items.titleZh: 为哥伦比亚地震人道主义救援捐款 10 万欧元
items.descriptionZh: FC Barcelona 与巴萨基金会启动特别募款行动，与当地主要救援组织合作帮助受灾民众。

items.title: Kounde rejoins training
items.description: The Frenchman trained for the first time following his holiday and his participation in the World Cup
items.descriptionZh: 结束假期并参加世界杯后，这名法国后卫首次回到训练场。

items.title: The Barça Foundation Logo to Appear for the First Time on the Back of the FC Barcelona Women’s Team Jersey
items.description: The first pre-season match of FC Barcelona Women will showcase the social work carried out by the Barça Foundation with children, adolescents, and young people in vulnerable situations
items.titleZh: 巴萨基金会标志将首次出现在女足球衣背面
items.descriptionZh: 女足首场季前赛将展示巴萨基金会面向弱势儿童、青少年和年轻人开展的社会工作。

items.title: Araujo loaned to Liverpool
items.description: Uruguayan defender will spend the coming season with the Reds
items.titleZh: 阿劳霍租借加盟利物浦
items.descriptionZh: 这名乌拉圭后卫将在新赛季为利物浦效力。

items.title: Aleksander Sekulic visits the Museum
items.description: New basketball coach says it is a responsibility and an honour to be part of an institution that is more than a club
items.titleZh: 亚历山大·塞库利奇参观巴萨博物馆
items.descriptionZh: 新任篮球主教练表示，成为这家“不止是一家俱乐部”的一员既是责任也是荣誉。

items.title: First training session of the week
items.description: Following the triangular tournament in Udine and the return of Gordon, Eric and Joan Garcia, Barça were back to work on Monday morning
items.titleZh: 新一周首堂训练课完成
items.descriptionZh: 结束乌迪内三角赛并迎回戈登、埃里克和霍安·加西亚后，球队于周一上午恢复训练。

items.title: Barça returns to Egypt
items.description: Barça Academy will hold two camps, one in October and another in November
items.descriptionZh: 巴萨学院将在 10 月和 11 月分别举办一期训练营。
